usedFor: Perfex CRM issues the invoices and Google Sheets tracks them, so “New Invoice” runs “Add New Row to Sheet”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Invoice” in Perfex CRM, then “Add New Row to Sheet” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Each new invoice lands as a row, giving you a running list you can sort and total.

watchOut: A short delay before the row appears is normal, because “New Invoice” in Perfex CRM checks on a schedule.
